the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard
navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous control
ids.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setGrouped.htm)

methods.name: getCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:

methods.docu: [Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isdestroyed.htm)

methods.name: getUserData
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method retrieves user data associated with
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
using the method [setUserData().](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)
If setUserData() was not previously called on the control, then getUserData
returns BBjNull.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getuserdata.htm)

style name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removestyle.htm)

methods.name: getComputedStyle

the resolved value of a CSS property

methods.name: removeAttribute

methods.name: putClientProperty

methods.name: setProperty

methods.name: getProperty

methods.name: getParentWindow

In BBj 17.00 and higher, this
method returns the parent [BBjWindow](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjwindow/bbjwindow.htm) of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getParentWindow.htm)

methods.name: getClassList
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing all CSS class names currently defined on this [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClassList.htm)

methods.name: addClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_addClass.htm)

methods.name: removeClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeClass.htm)

methods.name: toggleClass
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method toggles a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_toggleClass.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, setAlignment sets the horizontal alignment of the text within the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextAlignable/interface_textalignable_setalignment.htm)

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, getAlignment returns a value indicating the text's horizontal alignment.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextAlignable/interface_textalignable_getalignment.htm)

methods.name: setDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the actions that will be allowed when this control acts as a drop target.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdropactions.htm)

methods.name: getDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control. Returns ACTION_NONE if the control is disabled or non-editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdropactions.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrols.htm)
is willing to accept from a drag source when it acts as a drop target.
If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setTabTraversable
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, setTabTraversable sets a value indicating
whether or not the user can navigate to the control using the tab
key.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TabTraversable/interface_tabtraversable_settabtraversable.htm)

methods.name: isTabTraversable
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, isTabTraversable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can navigate to the control using the tab key.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TabTraversable/interface_tabtraversable_istabtraversable.htm)

classes.name: DragSource

methods.name: setDragEnabled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.21 and higher, this method enables or disables dragging from this [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragenabled.htm)

methods.name: getDragEnabled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.21 and higher, this method returns a boolean that indicates whether dragging is currently enabled on this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragenabled.htm)

methods.name: setDragActions
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the available drag actions for
a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragactions.htm)

methods.name: getDragActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dragging from this control. If the control is disabled or non-editable, the MOVE action is unavailable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragactions.htm)

methods.name: setDragType
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets an optional type string that this control advertises to potential drop targets when it acts as a drag source.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragtype.htm)

methods.name: getDragType
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns an optional type string, previously set with [setDragType](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragtype.htm)(), that this control advertises to potential drop targets when it acts as a drag source.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragtype.htm)

classes.name: TextControl
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, all text-based [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)s
implement the TextControl interface.
When spell checking is enabled, the text control monitors the user's typing,
underlines misspelled words, and adds a popup menu with options to correct
spelling mistakes.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol.htm)

methods.name: getHighlightOnFocus
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns an integer representing the current behavior of highlighting in a text control when the control receives focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_gethighlightonfocus.htm)

methods.name: setHighlightOnFocus
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the behavior of controls implementing the TextControl interface when receiving focus via the keyboard, mouse, or [BBjControl::focus](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_focus.htm)() method [FOCUS mnemonic](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/mnemonic/syswindow/focus_mn_set_keyboard_focus.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_sethighlightonfocus.htm)

methods.name: setSpellChecked
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method specifies whether a text control should be spell checked.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setspellchecked.htm)

methods.name: isSpellChecked
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns whether spell checking is currently active in a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_isspellchecked.htm)

methods.name: setSpellCheckLanguage
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this specifies the language that should be used to spell check a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setspellchecklanguage.htm)

methods.name: getSpellCheckLanguage
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the language that is currently being used to spell check a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getspellchecklanguage.htm)

methods.name: setLocale
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this specifies the user interface language for a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setlocale.htm)

methods.name: getLocale
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the user interface language for a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getlocale.htm)

methods.name: setSpellCheckOption
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method modifies low level spell checking options.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setspellcheckoption.htm)

methods.name: getSpellCheckOption
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, getSpellCheckOption can be used to query the values of low level spell-checking options.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getspellcheckoption.htm)

methods.name: setSpellCheckColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the color of the jagged underline
that indicates misspelled word.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setspellcheckcolor.htm)

methods.name: getSpellCheckColor
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the color of the jagged underline that indicates misspelled words.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getspellcheckcolor.htm)

methods.name: setCustomDictionary
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the name of the server-side file that will contain new words added to the dictionary.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setcustomdictionary.htm)

methods.name: getCustomDictionary
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the server-side file that contains new words added to the dictionary.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getcustomdictionary.htm)

methods.name: setMaxSuggestions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the maximum number of suggestions to be returned by [getSuggestions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getsuggestions.htm) or presented when the user right-clicks on a misspelled word.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_setmaxsuggestions.htm)

methods.name: getMaxSuggestions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum number of suggestions to be returned by [getSuggestions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getsuggestions.htm) or presented when the user right-clicks on a misspelled word.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getmaxsuggestions.htm)

methods.name: getMisspelledWords
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, getMisspelledWords returns a BBjVector containing all unique words currently marked as misspelled in a spell-checked text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getmisspelledwords.htm)

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns suggested corrections for a misspelled word.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_getsuggestions.htm)

methods.name: isMisspelled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns whether a word is considered to be misspelled based on the current settings in this spell checked text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_ismisspelled.htm)

methods.name: addWord
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method adds a word to the server-side custom dictionary file, and marks the word as not misspelled in the spell checked text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_addword.htm)

methods.name: removeWord
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method removes a word from the custom dictionary file. If the word does not exist in the permanent dictionary files, it will be considered misspelled in the spell checked text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_removeword.htm)

methods.name: ignoreWord
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method marks a word as not misspelled in a spell checked text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/interface_textcontrol_ignoreword.htm)

methods.name: setLeftMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the width of the inside left margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setLeftMargin.htm)

methods.name: setRightMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the width of the inside left margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setRightMargin.htm)

methods.name: setTopMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the width of the inside top margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setTopMargin.htm)

methods.name: setBottomMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the width of the inside bottom margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setBottomMargin.htm)

methods.name: getLeftMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the width of the inside left margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getLeftMargin.htm)

methods.name: getRightMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the width of the inside right margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getRightMargin.htm)

methods.name: getTopMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the width of the inside top margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getTopMargin.htm)

methods.name: getBottomMargin
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the width of the inside bottom margin of a text control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getBottomMargin.htm)

methods.name: getDisabledTextColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the text color of a text
control when it is disabled[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getDisabledTextColor.htm)

methods.name: setDisabledTextColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets the text color of a text control
when it is disabled[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setDisabledTextColor.htm)

methods.name: setPlaceholder
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method sets the placeholder text to be shown when the
text control is empty.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setPlaceholder.htm)

methods.name: getPlaceholder
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns the placeholder text to be shown
when the text control is empty.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getPlaceholder.htm)

methods.name: getPlaceholderColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns
the color of the placeholder text to be shown when the text control is
empty.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_getPlaceholderColor.htm)

methods.name: setPlaceholderColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets
the color of the placeholder text to be shown when the text control is
empty.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextControl/Interface_TextControl_setPlaceholderColor.htm)

classes.name: BBjInputD
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, the BBjInputD object provides methods for manipulating
a GUI date control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm)

methods.name: setValue
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the value of the [BBjInputD](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm)
control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd_setvalue.htm)

methods.name: getValue
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the value of a [BBjInputD](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm) control as a Julian date.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd_getvalue.htm)

methods.name: setLocale
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the locale for the [BBjInputD](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm)
control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd_setlocale.htm)

methods.name: getLocale
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the locale of the [BBjInputD](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm) control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd_getlocale.htm)

methods.name: setShowWeeks
methods.docu:

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

classes.name: BBjStandardGrid
classes.docu:
A BBjStandardGrid provides methods for manipulating a standard grid
control in BBj. For Data Aware grids see [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).
The BBjStandardGrid extends the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
object and therefore implements all methods in the BBjGrid. A BBjStandardGrid
can be converted to a BBjDataAwareGrid using the method [BBjStandardGrid::convertToDataAware](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_converttodataaware.htm).
After conversion, the BBjStandardGrid object is no longer valid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm)

methods.name: clear
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method removes all restore, images, related, text,
column and row header, and selection data from the grid in the [BBjStandardGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/BBjStandardGrid_clear.htm)

methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method is deprecated. Use `[clear](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/BBjStandardGrid_clear.htm)()`,
`[clearImage](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/BBjStandardGrid_clearImage.htm)()`,
`[clearRelated](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/BBjStandardGrid_clearRelated.htm)()`,

methods.name: getCellText
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the text stored in the specified cell.

For a [BBjStandardGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm),
this value is the empty string when the BBjStandardGrid is created
and changes when the program calls [setCellText](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_setcelltext.htm)().
For [BBjDataBoundGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm)
and [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
this value is set when the grid is bound to a data source.

For all grids this value is modified when the user edits the cell and
then leaves the cell. If a validation routine is triggered by
the editing of the cell, then the value returned by getCellText()
does not change until the validation event is accepted.

Note: If the type of the cell is InputN, InputE or InputD, then the
value that is displayed to the user is obtained by applying the mask returned
by [getCellMask](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_getcellmask.htm)()
to the text value that is obtained by getCellText(). This means that
the text that is displayed to the user may be different from the value
that is returned by getCellText()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getcelltext.htm)

[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gethorizontallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalScrollable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the horizontal scrollbar will appear if there are more
columns than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_gethorizontalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns whether to show a horizontal scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setHorizontalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm), or to show the horizontal scrollbar only as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_gethorizontalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: getInsertMode
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) value that indicates whether the editor is in insert mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getinsertmode.htm)

methods.name: getInterspace
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method is
deprecated; use [getHorizontalCellSpacing](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gethorizontalcellspacing.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getinterspace.htm)

methods.name: getLeftColumn
methods.docu: Returns the current visible left-most column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getleftcolumn.htm)

methods.name: getLineColor
methods.docu: Returns the color of the separator lines in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getlinecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridAlignment
methods.docu: Returns the alignment of the cells in the main part of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) (not including the row or column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_getmaingridalignment.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridBackColor
methods.docu: Returns the default background color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridFont
methods.docu: Returns the default font of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_getmaingridfont.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridForeColor
methods.docu: Returns the default foreground color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridforecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridStripeColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the background stripe color
of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridstripecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridVerticalAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the vertical alignment of the cells in the main part of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) (not including the row or column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_getmaingridverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: getMaxVisibleColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum number of columns
that will fit inside the visible viewing area of the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getMaxVisibleColumns.htm)

methods.name: getMaxVisibleRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum number of rows
that will fit inside the visible viewing area of the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getMaxVisibleRows.htm)

methods.name: getNumColumns
methods.docu: Returns the number of columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getnumcolumns.htm)

methods.name: getNumRows
methods.docu: Returns the number of rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getnumrows.htm)

methods.name: getPagingAmount
methods.docu:
Returns the number of rows to scroll when scrolling by page in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getpagingamount.htm)

methods.name: getRowData
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
row or rows. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getRowData.htm)

methods.name: getRowData
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
row or rows. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getRowData.htm)

methods.name: getRowGutter
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the number of pixels separating
the row header and the main grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_getrowgutter.htm)

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getrowheight.htm)

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getrowheight.htm)

methods.name: getRowStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all CSS styles names that
have been added to a grid row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_getrowstylenames.htm)

methods.name: getRowVerticalAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the vertical alignment of all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_getRowVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: getScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent
methods.docu: In BBj 20.10 and higher, this method returns value of the boolean flag indicating whether the [BBjGridHitTopEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhittopevent/bbjgridhittopevent.htm) and [BBjGridHitBottomEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhitbottomevent/bbjgridhitbottomevent.htm) events will trigger from the scrollbar.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/BBjGrid_getScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent.htm)

methods.name: getScrollOutside
methods.docu:
Returns whether the grid will scroll when the mouse cursor is moved
outside the bounds of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
during a drag and drop operation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getscrolloutside.htm)

methods.name: getScrollUpdate
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
updates while being scrolled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getscrollupdate.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCell
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_getSelectedCell.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the selected cells in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection
mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple cells.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_getSelectedCells.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedColumn
methods.docu: Returns the currently selected column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedcolumn.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the
selected columns in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode
([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple columns.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedcolumns.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedRow
methods.docu: Returns the currently selected row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the
selected rows in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple rows.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedrows.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionBackground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current background [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value for a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionBackground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionForeground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current foreground [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm) value for a selection
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionForeground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionMode
methods.docu: Returns the selection mode of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire column of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedRow
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire row of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getshouldhighlightselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: getShowMaskWhenRendering
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether
input style cells display the decoration characters of their mask in non-edit
mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getshowmaskwhenrendering.htm)

methods.name: getSnapToRowHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether the gird will adjust its height so that only full rows appear in the grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getsnaptorowheight.htm)

methods.name: getStartEditSelectionMode
methods.docu: In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns the selection mode that will be used when starting to edit a cell in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_getstarteditselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getStringWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of a string in pixels in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getstringwidth.htm)

methods.name: getStripeCount
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the number of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) rows to alternate between the stripe color and the default background color.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getstripecount.htm)

methods.name: getTabAction
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the current tab action in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm)

methods.name: getTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells
methods.docu: When the user presses Tab key while focus is on a grid cell, the focus will move based on the current TabAction of the grid (see [getTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm), [setTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)). If the program has called setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells(TRUE), then the focus will skip any cells that are not editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabactionskipsnoneditablecells.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getTopRow
methods.docu: Returns the current top visible row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettoprow.htm)

methods.name: getTrimBlankSpace
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of this grid will trim its size if it is larger than the size needed to display the field table, all headers and all scrollbars.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_gettrimblankspace.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, returns the amount of space between the rows
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getverticalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Returns whether the vertical lines between columns are visible in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getverticallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalScrollable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the vertical scrollbar will appear if there are more
rows than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getverticalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this returns whether to always show a vertical scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setVerticalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setverticalscrollable.htm), or to only show the vertical scrollbar as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getverticalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleColumnCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the number of columns that
are currently visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/deprecated/BBjGrid_getVisibleColumnCount.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this function returns the current number of
visible columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getVisibleColumns.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleRowCount
methods.docu: Returns the number of rows that are currently visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getvisiblerowcount.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this function returns the current number of
visible rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getVisibleRows.htm)

methods.name: isColumnEditable
methods.docu: Returns whether a column is editable in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_iscolumneditable.htm)

methods.name: isColumnVisible
methods.docu:
Returns a boolean indicating whether the specified column is visible
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_iscolumnvisible.htm)

methods.name: isDataAware
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is data aware.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_isdataaware.htm)

methods.name: isDataBound
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, returns true if the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is [BBjDataBound](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_isdatabound.htm)

methods.name: isEditable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_iseditable.htm)

methods.name: isEditing
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is currently in edit mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_isediting.htm)

methods.name: isEditOnKeyPress
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method determines if editing on keypress
is enabled for the specified cells.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/BBjGrid_isEditOnKeyPress.htm)

methods.name: isEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates
which selection model is currently being used in the grid; the Enhanced
or Legacy Selection Model.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_isEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isEnterAsTab
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method
returns whether pressing Enter while focus is on the grid will be interpreted
as though the user had pressed Tab.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_isenterastab.htm)

methods.name: isFitToGrid
methods.docu: Returns whether to fit all columns into the displayed width of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_isfittogrid.htm)

methods.name: isMultipleSelectionAllowed
methods.docu: Returns whether multiple selection is allowed in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_ismultipleselectionallowed.htm)

methods.name: isPaging
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be scrolled with paging buttons ( and ) and if the paging amount can be changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_ispaging.htm)

methods.name: isRowVisible
methods.docu:
Returns a boolean indicating whether the specified row is visible in

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: getDragEnabled

methods.name: getDragType

methods.name: setDropActions

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage

methods.name: isClientValidationValid

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setEditable

methods.name: isEditable

methods.name: getClientValidationFunction

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage

methods.name: isClientValidationValid

methods.name: setClientValidationFunction
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, this method is used to specify a client-side JavaScript function that will validate the contents of this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationFunction.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationMessage

methods.name: setSpellCheckOption

methods.name: getSpellCheckOption

methods.name: getSuggestions

methods.name: setAlignment

methods.name: setDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the actions that will be allowed when this control acts as a drop target.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdropactions.htm)

methods.name: getDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control. methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrols.htm)
is willing to accept from a drag source when it acts as a drop target.
If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setDragEnabled

methods.name: getDragEnabled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.21 and higher, this method returns a boolean that indicates whether dragging is currently enabled on this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragenabled.htm)

methods.name: setDragActions

a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragactions.htm)

methods.name: getDragActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dragging from this control. If the control is disabled or non-editable, the MOVE action is unavailable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragactions.htm)

methods.name: setDragType

methods.name: getDragType

methods.name: getBoundRecordSet

methods.name: setTabTraversable

In BBj 4.00 and higher, setTabTraversable sets a value indicating
whether or not the user can navigate to the control using the tab

methods.name: isTabTraversable

classes.name: BBjColorChooser
classes.docu:

methods.name: isPreviewPanelVisible

methods.name: setPreviewPanelVisible

methods.name: getCancelButtonText

methods.name: getStyles
methods.docu:

methods.name: setStyle

a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) property on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setStyle.htm)

methods.name: getStyle

methods.name: setAttribute

methods.docu: In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method returns a boolean value indicating whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has the specified attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: isTabTraversable

classes.name: BBjNavigator
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, the BBjNavigator object provides methods for
manipulating a GUI navigator control. The Navigator panel contains four
buttons – "|<" (First), "<" (Previous), ">"
(Next) and ">|" (Last). Clicking on the buttons fires events
that can be handled based on the needs of the application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjnavigator/bbjnavigator.htm)

methods.name: getTargetRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the Target RecordSet associated with a [BBjNavigator](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjnavigator/bbjnavigator.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjnavigator/bbjnavigator_gettargetrecordset.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

is part of a [keyboard navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous

the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: getBottomMargin
