selected rows in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple rows.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedrows.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionBackground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current background [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value for a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionBackground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionForeground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current foreground [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm) value for a selection
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionForeground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionMode
methods.docu: Returns the selection mode of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire column of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedRow
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire row of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getshouldhighlightselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: getShowMaskWhenRendering
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether
input style cells display the decoration characters of their mask in non-edit
mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getshowmaskwhenrendering.htm)

methods.name: getSnapToRowHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether the gird will adjust its height so that only full rows appear in the grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getsnaptorowheight.htm)

methods.name: getStartEditSelectionMode
methods.docu: In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns the selection mode that will be used when starting to edit a cell in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_getstarteditselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getStringWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of a string in pixels in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getstringwidth.htm)

methods.name: getStripeCount
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the number of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) rows to alternate between the stripe color and the default background color.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getstripecount.htm)

methods.name: getTabAction
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the current tab action in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm)

methods.name: getTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells
methods.docu: When the user presses Tab key while focus is on a grid cell, the focus will move based on the current TabAction of the grid (see [getTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm), [setTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)). If the program has called setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells(TRUE), then the focus will skip any cells that are not editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabactionskipsnoneditablecells.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getTopRow
methods.docu: Returns the current top visible row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettoprow.htm)

methods.name: getTrimBlankSpace
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of this grid will trim its size if it is larger than the size needed to display the field table, all headers and all scrollbars.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_gettrimblankspace.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, returns the amount of space between the rows
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getverticalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Returns whether the vertical lines between columns are visible in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getverticallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalScrollable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the vertical scrollbar will appear if there are more
rows than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getverticalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this returns whether to always show a vertical scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setVerticalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setverticalscrollable.htm), or to only show the vertical scrollbar as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getverticalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleColumnCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the number of columns that
are currently visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/deprecated/BBjGrid_getVisibleColumnCount.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this function returns the current number of
visible columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getVisibleColumns.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleRowCount
methods.docu: Returns the number of rows that are currently visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getvisiblerowcount.htm)

methods.name: getVisibleRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this function returns the current number of
visible rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getVisibleRows.htm)

methods.name: isColumnEditable
methods.docu: Returns whether a column is editable in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_iscolumneditable.htm)

methods.name: isColumnVisible
methods.docu:
Returns a boolean indicating whether the specified column is visible
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_iscolumnvisible.htm)

methods.name: isDataAware
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is data aware.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_isdataaware.htm)

methods.name: isDataBound
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, returns true if the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is [BBjDataBound](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_isdatabound.htm)

methods.name: isEditable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_iseditable.htm)

methods.name: isEditing
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is currently in edit mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_isediting.htm)

methods.name: isEditOnKeyPress
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method determines if editing on keypress
is enabled for the specified cells.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/BBjGrid_isEditOnKeyPress.htm)

methods.name: isEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates
which selection model is currently being used in the grid; the Enhanced
or Legacy Selection Model.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_isEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isEnterAsTab
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method
returns whether pressing Enter while focus is on the grid will be interpreted
as though the user had pressed Tab.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_isenterastab.htm)

methods.name: isFitToGrid
methods.docu: Returns whether to fit all columns into the displayed width of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_isfittogrid.htm)

methods.name: isMultipleSelectionAllowed
methods.docu: Returns whether multiple selection is allowed in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_ismultipleselectionallowed.htm)

methods.name: isPaging
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be scrolled with paging buttons ( and ) and if the paging amount can be changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_ispaging.htm)

methods.name: isRowVisible
methods.docu:
Returns a boolean indicating whether the specified row is visible in
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_isrowvisible.htm)

methods.name: isSelected
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method
returns whether a specific grid cell is selected.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_isSelected.htm)

methods.name: isSelected
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method
returns whether a specific grid cell is selected.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_isSelected.htm)

methods.name: isUserResizable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be resized by the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_isuserresizable.htm)

methods.name: makeCell
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method creates a new [BBjGridCell](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_makeCell.htm)

methods.name: moveToNextCell
methods.docu: Moves the selection to the next cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_movetonextcell.htm)

methods.name: removeCellStyleName
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method removes a CSS style name from
a grid cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_removecellstylename.htm)

methods.name: removeColumnStyleName
methods.docu: In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method removes a CSS style name from a grid column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_removecolumnstylename.htm)

methods.name: removeRowStyleName
methods.docu: In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method removes a CSS style name from a grid row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_removerowstylename.htm)

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.docu: Scrolls down in order to set the bottom row visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_scrolltobottom.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets whether a grid should beep when the application calls accept(0) during validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_setbeeponvalidationfailure.htm)

methods.name: setCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
the [BBjGridCell](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) data
to the grid. The default data contained within the BBjGridCell
will not get updated to the grid. Only the changed user specific data
within the BBjGridCell will be updated to the grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setCell.htm)

methods.name: setCells
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
to the grid. The default data contained within the BBjGridCells will not
get updated to the grid. Only the changed user-specific data within the
BBjGridCells will be changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setCells.htm)

methods.name: setColumnAlignment
methods.docu: Sets the default alignment for a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setcolumnalignment.htm)

methods.name: setColumnBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the background color of a column of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnEditable
methods.docu: Sets whether a column is editable in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_setcolumneditable.htm)

methods.name: setColumnFont
methods.docu: Sets the default font of a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_setcolumnfont.htm)

methods.name: setColumnForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the foreground color for a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnGutter
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the number of pixels separating
the column header and the main [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_setcolumngutter.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderAlignment
methods.docu: Sets the default column header alignment for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderalignment.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the background color of the column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellAlignment
methods.docu: Sets the alignment for the column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellalignment.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the background color of a column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the foreground color of a column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellIcon
methods.docu: Sets the icon in a column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/iconfunctions/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellicon.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellImage
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets the image displayed in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) column header
cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/iconfunctions/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellimage.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellStyle
methods.docu: Sets the cell style used for a column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellstyle/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellstyle.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellText
methods.docu: Sets the text to be displayed in a column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercelltext.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderCellVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the vertical alignment for the
column header cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadercellverticalalignment_.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderFont
methods.docu: Sets the font of the column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderfont.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the default foreground color of the column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, sets the height of the column header in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderheight.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderStyle
methods.docu: Sets the style used for a column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellstyle/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderstyle.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderText
methods.docu: Sets the column header text in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_setcolumnheadertext.htm)

methods.name: setColumnHeaderVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this sets the default vertical alignment for
the column header in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setcolumnheaderverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: setColumnMask
methods.docu: Sets the default mask for all cells in a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_setcolumnmask.htm)

methods.name: setColumnVerticalAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets the cell vertical alignment for all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_setColumnVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: setColumnVisible
methods.docu:
Scrolls the BBjGrid, if necessary, to ensure that the specified column
appears within the visible area.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setcolumnvisible.htm)

methods.name: setColumnWidth
methods.docu: Sets the width of a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setcolumnwidth.htm)

methods.name: setDefaultAlignment
methods.docu: Sets the default alignment for all of the cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setdefaultalignment.htm)

methods.name: setDefaultColumnWidth
methods.docu: Sets the default width of all columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setdefaultcolumnwidth.htm)

methods.name: setDefaultVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
the default vertical alignment for all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_setDefaultVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: setDragAccept
methods.docu: Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) will accept drag and drop operations.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdragaccept.htm)

methods.name: setDragType
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets an optional type string that
an individual grid column or cell advertises to potential drop targets
when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
acts as a drag source.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdragtype.htm)

methods.name: setDragType
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets an optional type string that
an individual grid column or cell advertises to potential drop targets
when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
acts as a drag source.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdragtype.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that an individual grid column
or cell is willing to accept from a drag source when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
acts as a drop target. If no drop types are set, the grid will accept
data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that an individual grid column
or cell is willing to accept from a drag source when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
acts as a drop target. If no drop types are set, the grid will accept
data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setEditable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
are editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)

methods.name: setEditClickCount
methods.docu:
Sets the number of mouse clicks needed to begin editing a cell in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditclickcount.htm)

methods.name: setEditOnKeyPress
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets a flag to enable or disable
the ability to edit cells directly on a keypress.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/BBjGrid_setEditOnKeyPress.htm)

methods.name: setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method enables the Enhanced Selection Model
scheme for the current grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled.htm)

methods.name: setEnterAsTab
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method sets whether an
ENTER key that is pressed while focus is on the grid will be interpreted
as though a TAB key had been pressed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setenterastab.htm)

methods.name: setFitToGrid
methods.docu:
Specifies whether to fit all columns into the displayed width of the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setfittogrid.htm)

methods.name: setHasColumnHeader
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
has a column header.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_sethascolumnheader.htm)

methods.name: setHeaderSelection
methods.docu: Sets whether a header cell will display as recessed if the row/column is selected in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setheaderselection.htm)

methods.name: setHighlightMethod
methods.docu: Sets the highlight method for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_sethighlightmethod.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, sets the amount of space between the columns
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Sets whether the horizontal lines between the rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
are visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalScrollable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the horizontal scrollbar will appear if there are more
columns than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets whether to always show a horizontal scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setHorizontalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm), or to only show as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: setInsertMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method controls whether the editor is in
insert mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_setinsertmode.htm)

methods.name: setInterspace
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method is
deprecated; use [setHorizontalCellSpacing](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontalcellspacing.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setinterspace.htm)

methods.name: setLeftColumn
methods.docu: In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method sets a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) to be the left-most visible column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setleftcolumn.htm)

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.docu: Sets the line color of the vertical and horizontal lines in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setlinecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridAlignment
methods.docu:
Sets the alignment for all of the cells in the main area of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
(not including the row and column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setmaingridalignment.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the default background color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridFont
methods.docu: Sets the default font used in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_setmaingridfont.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the default foreground color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridStripeColor
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets an optional background stripe color of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridstripecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the vertical alignment for all
of the cells in the main area of the BBjGrid (not including the row and
column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setmaingridverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: setMouseCapture
methods.docu: Sets whether to capture mouse movement events in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setmousecapture.htm)

methods.name: setMultipleSelection
methods.docu: Sets whether multiple cells/rows/columns can be selected in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)

methods.name: setPaging
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be scrolled by paging buttons ( and ).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setpaging.htm)

methods.name: setPagingAmount
methods.docu: Sets the number of rows to scroll when scrolling by page in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setpagingamount.htm)

methods.name: setRowGutter
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the number of pixels separating
the row header and the main [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_setrowgutter.htm)

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.docu: Sets the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowheight.htm)

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.docu: Sets the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowheight.htm)

methods.name: setRowVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
the vertical alignment for all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_setRowVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: setRowVisible
methods.docu:
Scrolls the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm),
if necessary, to ensure that the specified row appears within the visible
area.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowvisible.htm)

methods.name: setScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent
methods.docu: In BBj 20.10 and higher, this method sets a flag to enable or disable the [BBjGridHitTopEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhittopevent/bbjgridhittopevent.htm) and [BBjGridHitBottomEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhitbottomevent/bbjgridhitbottomevent.htm) events while scrolling.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/BBjGrid_setScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent.htm)

methods.name: setScrollOutside
methods.docu:
Sets whether the grid scrolls during a drag and drop operation when
the mouse cursor is moved outside the bounds of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setscrolloutside.htm)

methods.name: setScrollUpdate
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
updates the display of data in the cells while being scrolled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setscrollupdate.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedCell
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method selects a cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setSelectedCell.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedCells
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method selects multiple cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setSelectedCells.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedColumn
methods.docu: Selects a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedcolumn.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method selects multiple columns in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedcolumns.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedRow
methods.docu: Selects a row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedRows
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method selects multiple rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedrows.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionBackground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets the background [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value for a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_setSelectionBackground.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionForeground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets the foreground [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value of a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_setSelectionForeground.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionMode
methods.docu: Sets the method to select cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: setShouldHighlightSelectedColumn
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will highlight
the entire column containing the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setShouldHighlightSelectedColumn.htm)

methods.name: setShouldHighlightSelectedRow
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will highlight
the entire row containing the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setshouldhighlightselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: setShowMaskWhenRendering
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method controls whether the input style
cells displays the decoration characters of their mask in non-edit mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/deprecated/bbjgrid_setshowmaskwhenrendering.htm)

methods.name: setSnapToRowHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will adjust its height so that it does not display any 'partial' rows.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setsnaptorowheight.htm)

methods.name: setStartEditSelectionMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method sets the selection mode that will
be used when a cell in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is edited.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_setstarteditselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: setStripeCount
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the number of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) rows to alternate between the stripe color and the default background color[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setstripecount.htm)

methods.name: setTabAction
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets the current tab action in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)

methods.name: setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells
methods.docu: When the user presses Tab key while focus is on a grid cell, the focus will move based on the current TabAction of the grid (see [getTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm), [setTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)). If the program has called setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells(TRUE) then the focus will skip any cells that are not editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabactionskipsnoneditablecells.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: setTopRow
methods.docu: Sets a row to be the top visible row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settoprow.htm)

methods.name: setTrimBlankSpace
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, when a grid is larger in size
than the size required to display the table and all required headers and
scrollbars, this method controls whether the grid will be trimmed to the
minimum size to display the table, headers and scrollbars.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_settrimblankspace.htm)

methods.name: setUserResizable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be resized by the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setuserresizable.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, sets the amount of space between the rows in
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setverticalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Sets whether the vertical lines between the columns are to be visible
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setverticallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalScrollable
methods.docu:

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: bindRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds the [RecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable.htm) to a particular field from a [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_bindrecordset.htm)

methods.name: getBoundFieldName

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setEditable

methods.name: isEditable
methods.docu: Returns a value indicating whether or not the user can edit the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Editable/interface_editable_iseditable.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationFunction

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage

methods.name: isClientValidationValid

methods.name: isClientValidationValid
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, isClientValidationValid returns a boolean value that indicates whether the client validation function, if any, currently reports that this control contains a valid value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_isClientValidationValid.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationFunction
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, this method is used to specify a client-side JavaScript function that will validate the contents of this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationFunction.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationMessage

methods.name: getSuggestions

methods.name: setAlignment

methods.name: getDropActions

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrols.htm)
is willing to accept from a drag source when it acts as a drop target.
If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes

methods.name: setDragEnabled

methods.name: getDragEnabled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.21 and higher, this method returns a boolean that indicates whether dragging is currently enabled on this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragenabled.htm)

methods.name: setDragActions

methods.name: getDragActions

methods.name: setDragType

methods.name: getDragType

methods.name: getBoundRecordSet

methods.name: setTabTraversable

methods.name: toggleClass

methods.name: setSlot

If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, getClientValidationMessage returns the error message to be displayed next to this control when the client validation function returns boolean false (invalid).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_getClientValidationMessage.htm)

methods.name: isClientValidationValid
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, isClientValidationValid returns a boolean value that indicates whether the client validation function, if any, currently reports that this control contains a valid value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_isClientValidationValid.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationFunction

classes.name: Scrollable

methods.name: isVerticalScrollBarVisible

methods.name: getVerticalScrollBarWidth

classes.name: BBjGrid
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, the BBjGrid is the abstract base class for [BBjStandardGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm), [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
and [BBjDataBoundGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm). BBjGrid contains
the methods that are common to BBjStandardGrid, BBjDataAwareGrid, and
BBjDataBoundGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

methods.name: addCellStyleName
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method adds a CSS style name to a
grid cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addcellstylename.htm)

methods.name: addColumnStyleName
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method adds a CSS style name to a
grid column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addcolumnstylename.htm)

methods.name: addRowStyleName
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method adds a CSS style name to a
grid row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addrowstylename.htm)

methods.name: adjustSpacesWhenDisplaying
methods.docu:

spaces contained in data before displaying within a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_adjustspaceswhendisplaying.htm)

methods.name: adjustSpacesWhenSaving
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method adjusts, for a given [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
column, the spaces the developer entered before returning it to the program.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_adjustspaceswhensaving.htm)

methods.name: clearCellStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method clears CSS styles from a grid
cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_clearcellstylenames.htm)

methods.name: clearColumnStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method clears CSS styles from a grid
column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_clearcolumnstylenames.htm)

methods.name: clearRowStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method clears CSS styles from a grid
row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_clearrowstylenames.htm)

methods.name: deselectAllCells
methods.docu: Deselects all of the cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_deselectallcells.htm)

methods.name: doLowerCaseWhenDisplaying

In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method adjusts, for a given [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

methods.name: doUpperCaseWhenDisplaying

methods.name: getBeepOnValidationFailure

methods.name: getBottomRow
methods.docu: Returns the current visible bottom row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getbottomrow.htm)

methods.name: getCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the [BBjGridCell](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) data
of the grid cell. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getCell.htm)

methods.name: getCellRange
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) in [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
range of cells. The data returned is a snapshot of the current state
of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within the
BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getCellRange.htm)

methods.name: getCellStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all CSS style
names that have been added to a grid cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_getcellstylenames.htm)

methods.name: getCellText
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the text stored in the specified cell.

For a [BBjStandardGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm),
this value is the empty string when the BBjStandardGrid is created
and changes when the program calls [setCellText](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_setcelltext.htm)().
For [BBjDataBoundGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm)
and [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
this value is set when the grid is bound to a data source.

For all grids this value is modified when the user edits the cell and
then leaves the cell. If a validation routine is triggered by
the editing of the cell, then the value returned by getCellText()
does not change until the validation event is accepted.

Note: If the type of the cell is InputN, InputE or InputD, then the
value that is displayed to the user is obtained by applying the mask returned
by [getCellMask](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_getcellmask.htm)()
to the text value that is obtained by getCellText(). This means that
the text that is displayed to the user may be different from the value
that is returned by getCellText()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getcelltext.htm)
