Sets the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlongcue.htm)

methods.name: getLongCue
methods.docu:
Returns the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getlongcue.htm)

methods.name: isGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous
control IDs.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_isGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets whether
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard
navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous control
ids.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets whether entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns whether or not entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) will beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) in response to a validation event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method sets whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) should beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) during validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setSize
methods.docu: Sets the size of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setsize.htm)

methods.name: getWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getwidth.htm)

methods.name: getHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getheight.htm)

methods.name: setLocation
methods.docu: Sets the location of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlocation.htm)

methods.name: getX
methods.docu: Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getx.htm)

methods.name: getY
methods.docu: Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gety.htm)

methods.name: getScreenX
methods.docu:
Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreenx.htm)

methods.name: getScreenY
methods.docu:
Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreeny.htm)

methods.name: setClientEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a client (lowered) border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setclientedge.htm)

methods.name: getClientEdge
methods.docu: Returns whether the client (lowered) border is set for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getclientedge.htm)

methods.name: setRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setraisededge.htm)

methods.name: getRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
has a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getraisededge.htm)

methods.name: setNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) to have no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setnoedge.htm)

methods.name: getNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getnoedge.htm)

methods.name: setOpaque
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method sets the opaque property of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setopaque.htm)

methods.name: isOpaque
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method returns the opaque property of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isopaque.htm)

methods.name: focus
methods.docu: Sets the focus on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_focus.htm)

methods.name: getID
methods.docu: Returns the ID of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getid.htm)

methods.name: getControlType
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method returns the control type of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcontroltype.htm)

methods.name: destroy
methods.docu: This method destroys a control. It removes the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) from the window and allows its ID to be used again.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_destroy.htm)

methods.name: isDestroyed
methods.docu: [Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isdestroyed.htm)

methods.name: setUserData
methods.docu: In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method associates an Object with the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)

methods.name: getUserData
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method retrieves user data associated with
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
using the method [setUserData().](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)
If setUserData() was not previously called on the control, then getUserData
returns BBjNull.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getuserdata.htm)

methods.name: setCursor
methods.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, this
method sets the cursor style on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcursor.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getname.htm)

methods.name: setName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the name of a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setname.htm)

methods.name: addStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_addstyle.htm)

methods.name: removeStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removestyle.htm)

methods.name: clearStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method clears [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
styles from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_clearstyles.htm)

methods.name: getStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style names that have been added to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getstyles.htm)

methods.name: setStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) property on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setStyle.htm)

methods.name: getStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the value of a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
property explicitly set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getStyle.htm)

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the resolved value of a CSS property
currently in effect on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getComputedStyle.htm)

methods.name: unsetStyle
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method unsets a CSS property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_unsetStyle.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets a control attribute on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a control attribute for
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
previously set with [BBjControl::setAttribute](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getAttribute.htm)

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method returns a boolean value indicating whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has the specified attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 22.13 and higher, this method removes a control attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeAttribute.htm)

methods.name: putClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets a client property on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: getClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously
set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
with [BBjControl::putClientProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getParentWindow
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this
method returns the parent [BBjWindow](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjwindow/bbjwindow.htm) of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getParentWindow.htm)

methods.name: getClassList
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing all CSS class names currently defined on this [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClassList.htm)

methods.name: addClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_addClass.htm)

methods.name: removeClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeClass.htm)

methods.name: toggleClass
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method toggles a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_toggleClass.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: setDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the actions that will be allowed when this control acts as a drop target.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdropactions.htm)

methods.name: getDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control. Returns ACTION_NONE if the control is disabled or non-editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdropactions.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrols.htm)
is willing to accept from a drag source when it acts as a drop target.
If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdroptypes.htm)

classes.name: BBjListSpinner
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, the BBjListSpinner is an abstract class of the
[BBjInputESpinner](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputespinner.htm) and the [BBjEditBoxSpinner](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjeditboxspinner.htm)
spinner controls that spin over a list.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjlistspinner/bbjlistspinner.htm)

methods.name: getSpinList
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this [BBjListSpinner](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjlistspinner/bbjlistspinner.htm) method returns the list previously set on the [BBjListSpinner](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjlistspinner/bbjlistspinner.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjlistspinner/bbjlistspinner_getspinlist.htm)

In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) property on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setStyle.htm)

methods.name: getStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the value of a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
property explicitly set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getStyle.htm)

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the resolved value of a CSS property
currently in effect on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getComputedStyle.htm)

methods.name: unsetStyle
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method unsets a CSS property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_unsetStyle.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets a control attribute on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a control attribute for
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
previously set with [BBjControl::setAttribute](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getAttribute.htm)

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method returns a boolean value indicating whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has the specified attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 22.13 and higher, this method removes a control attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeAttribute.htm)

methods.name: putClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets a client property on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: getClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously
set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
with [BBjControl::putClientProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getParentWindow
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this
method returns the parent [BBjWindow](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjwindow/bbjwindow.htm) of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getParentWindow.htm)

methods.name: getClassList
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing all CSS class names currently defined on this [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClassList.htm)

methods.name: addClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_addClass.htm)

methods.name: removeClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeClass.htm)

methods.name: toggleClass
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method toggles a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_toggleClass.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationFunction
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, getClientValidationFunction returns the JavaScript client validation function that was specified with [setClientValidationFunction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationFunction.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_getClientValidationFunction.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, getClientValidationMessage returns the error message to be displayed next to this control when the client validation function returns boolean false (invalid).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_getClientValidationMessage.htm)

methods.name: isClientValidationValid
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, isClientValidationValid returns a boolean value that indicates whether the client validation function, if any, currently reports that this control contains a valid value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_isClientValidationValid.htm)

methods.name: isClientValidationValid
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, isClientValidationValid returns a boolean value that indicates whether the client validation function, if any, currently reports that this control contains a valid value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_isClientValidationValid.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationFunction
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, this method is used to specify a client-side JavaScript function that will validate the contents of this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationFunction.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, this method is used to specify the message that will be displayed to the user when the control fails client validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationMessage.htm)

methods.name: bindRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds the [RecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable.htm) to a particular field from a [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_bindrecordset.htm)

methods.name: getBoundFieldName
methods.docu: In 5.0 and higher, this method returns the field name that is bound to this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_getboundfieldname.htm)

methods.name: getBoundRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm) to which this [SimpleRecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable.htm) object has previously been bound.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable_getboundrecordset.htm)

methods.name: unbindRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method removes the binding between this [SimpleRecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable.htm) object and any [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm) to which it was previously bound.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable_unbindrecordset.htm)

methods.name: setCallback
methods.docu: This method registers the callback routine for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcallback.htm)

methods.name: clearCallback
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method unregisters the callback routine
for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_clearcallback.htm)

methods.name: getContextID
methods.docu: Returns the context ID of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcontextid.htm)

methods.name: addPopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method adds a popup menu to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_addpopupmenu.htm)

methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds a pre-existing popup menu to
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: getPopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method retrieves a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: removePopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method removes a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removepopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: setText
methods.docu: Sets the text in the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_settext.htm)

methods.name: showToolTipText
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method shows the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) (also
known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

methods.name: isGrouped

In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous
control IDs.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_isGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets whether
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard
navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous control
ids.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets whether entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns whether or not entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) will beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) in response to a validation event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method sets whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) should beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) during validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isEditable
methods.docu: Returns a value indicating whether or not the user can edit the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Editable/interface_editable_iseditable.htm)

methods.name: getClientValidationFunction

methods.name: getClientValidationMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, getClientValidationMessage returns the error message to be displayed next to this control when the client validation function returns boolean false (invalid).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_getClientValidationMessage.htm)

methods.name: isClientValidationValid
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, isClientValidationValid returns a boolean value that indicates whether the client validation function, if any, currently reports that this control contains a valid value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_isClientValidationValid.htm)

methods.name: isClientValidationValid

methods.name: setClientValidationFunction
methods.docu: In BBj 22.10 and higher, this method is used to specify a client-side JavaScript function that will validate the contents of this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation_setClientValidationFunction.htm)

methods.name: setClientValidationMessage

methods.name: getSuggestions

the color of the placeholder text to be shown when the text control is

methods.name: setAlignment

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, getAlignment returns a value indicating the text's horizontal alignment.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_TextAlignable/interface_textalignable_getalignment.htm)

methods.name: setDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the actions that will be allowed when this control acts as a drop target.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdropactions.htm)

methods.name: getDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control. methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, these are the types that a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrols.htm)
is willing to accept from a drag source when it acts as a drop target.
If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setDragEnabled

methods.name: getDragEnabled
methods.docu: In BBj 7.21 and higher, this method returns a boolean that indicates whether dragging is currently enabled on this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragenabled.htm)

methods.name: setDragActions

In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the available drag actions for
a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_setdragactions.htm)

methods.name: getDragActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dragging from this control. If the control is disabled or non-editable, the MOVE action is unavailable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DragSource/interface_dragsource_getdragactions.htm)

methods.name: setDragType

methods.name: getDragType

methods.name: getBoundRecordSet

methods.name: setTabTraversable
methods.docu:

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setTabTraversable

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)
