Sets whether or not the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setvisible.htm)

methods.name: isVisible
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isvisible.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu:
Sets the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu:
Returns the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: showToolTipText
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method shows the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) (also
known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

methods.name: showToolTipText
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method shows the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) (also
known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

methods.name: setShortCue
methods.docu:
Sets the text that appears above the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setshortcue.htm)

methods.name: getShortCue
methods.docu:
Returns the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getshortcue.htm)

methods.name: setLongCue
methods.docu:
Sets the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlongcue.htm)

methods.name: getLongCue
methods.docu:
Returns the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getlongcue.htm)

methods.name: isGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous
control IDs.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_isGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets whether
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard
navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous control
ids.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets whether entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns whether or not entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) will beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) in response to a validation event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method sets whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) should beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) during validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setSize
methods.docu: Sets the size of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setsize.htm)

methods.name: getWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getwidth.htm)

methods.name: getHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getheight.htm)

methods.name: setLocation
methods.docu: Sets the location of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlocation.htm)

methods.name: getX
methods.docu: Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getx.htm)

methods.name: getY
methods.docu: Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gety.htm)

methods.name: getScreenX
methods.docu:
Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreenx.htm)

methods.name: getScreenY
methods.docu:
Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreeny.htm)

methods.name: setClientEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a client (lowered) border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setclientedge.htm)

methods.name: getClientEdge
methods.docu: Returns whether the client (lowered) border is set for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getclientedge.htm)

methods.name: setRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setraisededge.htm)

methods.name: getRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
has a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getraisededge.htm)

methods.name: setNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) to have no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setnoedge.htm)

methods.name: getNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getnoedge.htm)

methods.name: setOpaque
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method sets the opaque property of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setopaque.htm)

methods.name: isOpaque
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method returns the opaque property of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isopaque.htm)

methods.name: focus
methods.docu: Sets the focus on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_focus.htm)

methods.name: getID
methods.docu: Returns the ID of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getid.htm)

methods.name: getControlType
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method returns the control type of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcontroltype.htm)

methods.name: destroy
methods.docu: This method destroys a control. It removes the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) from the window and allows its ID to be used again.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_destroy.htm)

methods.name: isDestroyed
methods.docu: [Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isdestroyed.htm)

methods.name: setUserData
methods.docu: In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method associates an Object with the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)

methods.name: getUserData
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method retrieves user data associated with
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
using the method [setUserData().](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)
If setUserData() was not previously called on the control, then getUserData
returns BBjNull.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getuserdata.htm)

methods.name: setCursor
methods.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, this
method sets the cursor style on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcursor.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getname.htm)

methods.name: setName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the name of a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setname.htm)

methods.name: addStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_addstyle.htm)

methods.name: removeStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removestyle.htm)

methods.name: clearStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method clears [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
styles from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_clearstyles.htm)

methods.name: getStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style names that have been added to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getstyles.htm)

methods.name: setStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) property on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setStyle.htm)

methods.name: getStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the value of a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
property explicitly set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getStyle.htm)

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the resolved value of a CSS property
currently in effect on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getComputedStyle.htm)

methods.name: unsetStyle
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method unsets a CSS property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_unsetStyle.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets a control attribute on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a control attribute for
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
previously set with [BBjControl::setAttribute](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getAttribute.htm)

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method returns a boolean value indicating whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has the specified attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 22.13 and higher, this method removes a control attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeAttribute.htm)

methods.name: putClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets a client property on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: getClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously
set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
with [BBjControl::putClientProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously set with [BBjControl::setProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getProperty.htm)

methods.name: getParentWindow
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this
method returns the parent [BBjWindow](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjwindow/bbjwindow.htm) of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getParentWindow.htm)

methods.name: getClassList
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing all CSS class names currently defined on this [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClassList.htm)

methods.name: addClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_addClass.htm)

methods.name: removeClass
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeClass.htm)

methods.name: toggleClass
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method toggles a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) class name on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_toggleClass.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

classes.name: BBjHtmlView
classes.docu:
The BBjHtmlView control displays HTML files, and can act as a complete
embedded web browser, with support for HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.

The BBjHtmlView can be configured through STBL options to be either a basic container for static HTML 3.2 content, or a complete embedded Chromium-based browser. See STBL
Options for BBjHtmlView below.

Access to the CHROMIUM_HTMLVIEW feature requires an active Software Asset Management (SAM) subscription. See [Benefits
of ‘Software Asset Management' Feature Line](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/sysadmin/license/benefits_of_sam_feature_line.htm).

The WEBUI_HTMLVIEW feature is only available in the WebUI client, and requires a WebUI BLS license.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjhtmlview/bbjhtmlview.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

In BBj 4.00 and higher, setTabTraversable sets a value indicating

methods.name: isTabTraversable

If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes

classes.name: BBjDataAwareGrid

grid control in BBj. The BBjDataAwareGrid extends the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
object and therefore implements all the methods in BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)

methods.name: getRecord

Returns a record from the associated data file of a [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getrecord.htm)

methods.name: getShowInsertMessage
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, returns whether the confirm insert message is
being used in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getshowinsertmessage.htm)

methods.name: getShowUpdateMessage
methods.docu: Returns whether the confirm update message is being used in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getshowupdatemessage.htm)

methods.name: getUpdateBusyMessage
methods.docu:
Returns the message that is displayed in the update busy dialog box
when an attempt is made to update a locked record in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getupdatebusymessage.htm)

methods.name: getUpdateDeletedMessage
methods.docu:
Returns the message that is displayed in the update deleted dialog after
an update is attempted on a deleted record in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getupdatedeletedmessage.htm)

methods.name: getUpdateMessage
methods.docu:
Returns the message that is displayed in the update confirm dialog after
an update is attempted on a record in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_getupdatemessage.htm)

methods.name: insertRow
methods.docu: Inserts a row into the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_insertrow.htm)

methods.name: replaceCommasWhenDisplaying
methods.docu:

when displaying data in numeric cells of a given column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_replacecommaswhendisplaying.htm)

methods.name: replaceCommasWhenSaving
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method replaces the 'thousands' separator
when writing data from the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_replacecommaswhensaving.htm)

methods.name: replaceDecimalsWhenDisplaying
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method replaces the decimal character when
displaying data in numeric cells of a given column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_replacedecimalswhendisplaying.htm)

methods.name: replaceDecimalsWhenSaving
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the decimal character when writing
data from the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_replacedecimalswhensaving.htm)

methods.name: seekLastRecord
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method seeks to the last record of the channel
used to create the grid. While performing the seek, this method disables
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) and
displays a dialog box to the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_seeklastrecord.htm)

methods.name: seekLastRecord
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method seeks to the last record of the channel
used to create the grid. While performing the seek, this method disables
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) and
displays a dialog box to the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_seeklastrecord.htm)

methods.name: setDataChannel
methods.docu:
Sets the data channel which makes the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

methods.name: setInsertErrorMessage
methods.docu:
Sets the text used in the dialog box which is displayed when an attempt
to insert a record into the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
is not successful.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setinserterrormessage.htm)

methods.name: setInsertMessage
methods.docu:
Sets the message displayed in the confirm dialog box after an insert
is made in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setinsertmessage.htm)

methods.name: setShowInsertMessage
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, sets whether to display a confirm insert dialog
box after a change is made in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setshowinsertmessage.htm)

methods.name: setShowUpdateMessage
methods.docu:
Sets whether to display a confirm update dialog box after a change is
made in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setshowupdatemessage.htm)

methods.name: setUpdateBusyMessage
methods.docu:
Sets the text used in the dialog box which appears when an attempt to
update a record in the data-aware [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is unsuccessful because the record is being locked by another process.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setupdatebusymessage.htm)

methods.name: setUpdateDeletedMessage
methods.docu:
Sets the text used in the dialog box which appears when an attempt to
update a record in the data-aware [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is unsuccessful because the record has been deleted.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setupdatedeletedmessage.htm)

methods.name: setUpdateMessage
methods.docu:
Sets the text used in the confirm update dialog box, displayed when
a change is made in a row of data in the [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_setupdatemessage.htm)

methods.name: synchData
methods.docu:
Synchronizes a data-aware [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

methods.name: undoRowEdit
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method resets all cells in the current row
to the values prior to when the user began editing the row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/bbjdataawaregrid_undorowedit.htm)

methods.name: addCellStyleName

In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method adds a CSS style name to a
grid cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addcellstylename.htm)

methods.name: addColumnStyleName
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method adds a CSS style name to a
grid column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addcolumnstylename.htm)

methods.name: addRowStyleName

grid row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_addrowstylename.htm)

methods.name: adjustSpacesWhenSaving

methods.name: clearCellStyleNames

In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method clears CSS styles from a grid
cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_clearcellstylenames.htm)

methods.name: clearColumnStyleNames

In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method clears CSS styles from a grid
column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_clearcolumnstylenames.htm)

methods.name: clearRowStyleNames

into the displayed width of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_fillgridwithcolumns.htm)

methods.name: getBottomRow
methods.docu: Returns the current visible bottom row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getbottomrow.htm)

methods.name: getCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the [BBjGridCell](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) data
of the grid cell. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getCell.htm)

methods.name: getCellRange
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) in [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
range of cells. The data returned is a snapshot of the current state
of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within the
BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getCellRange.htm)

methods.name: getCellStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all CSS style
names that have been added to a grid cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_getcellstylenames.htm)

methods.name: getCellText
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the text stored in the specified cell.

For a [BBjStandardGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid.htm),
this value is the empty string when the BBjStandardGrid is created
and changes when the program calls [setCellText](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_setcelltext.htm)().
For [BBjDataBoundGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataboundgrid/bbjdataboundgrid.htm)
and [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm)
this value is set when the grid is bound to a data source.

For all grids this value is modified when the user edits the cell and
then leaves the cell. If a validation routine is triggered by
the editing of the cell, then the value returned by getCellText()
does not change until the validation event is accepted.

Note: If the type of the cell is InputN, InputE or InputD, then the
value that is displayed to the user is obtained by applying the mask returned
by [getCellMask](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjstandardgrid/bbjstandardgrid_getcellmask.htm)()
to the text value that is obtained by getCellText(). This means that
the text that is displayed to the user may be different from the value
that is returned by getCellText()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getcelltext.htm)

methods.name: getColumnHeaderStyle
methods.docu: Returns the style used by default for the column headers in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellstyle/bbjgrid_getcolumnheaderstyle.htm)

methods.name: getColumnHeaderVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this returns the default column header vertical
alignment in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_getcolumnheaderverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: getColumnMask
methods.docu: Returns the default mask for a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getcolumnmask.htm)

methods.name: getColumnStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all CSS styles names that
have been added to a grid column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_getcolumnstylenames.htm)

methods.name: getColumnVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns
the cell vertical alignment of all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_getColumnVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: getColumnWidth
methods.docu: Retrieves the width of a specified column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getcolumnwidth.htm)

methods.name: getColumnWidths
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the column widths within a grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getColumnWidths.htm)

methods.name: getColumnWidths
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the column widths within a grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getColumnWidths.htm)

methods.name: getDefaultColumnWidth
methods.docu: Returns the default column width of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getdefaultcolumnwidth.htm)

methods.name: getDragAccept
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
accepts drag and drop operations.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_getdragaccept.htm)

methods.name: getDragType
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drag type that was set
in a previous call to [setDragType](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdragtype.htm)
()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_getdragtype.htm)

methods.name: getDragType
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drag type that was set
in a previous call to [setDragType](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdragtype.htm)
()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_getdragtype.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were
set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)
().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_getdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the drop types that were
set in a previous call to [setDropTypes](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)
().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_getdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getEditClickCount
methods.docu:
Returns the number of mouse clicks needed to begin editing a cell in
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_geteditclickcount.htm)

methods.name: getEditText
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the edit text associated with the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_getedittext.htm)

methods.name: getHasColumnHeader
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
has a column header.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_gethascolumnheader.htm)

methods.name: getHeaderSelection
methods.docu: Returns whether the header selection is on in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getheaderselection.htm)

methods.name: getHighlightMethod
methods.docu: Returns which highlight method is being used in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gethighlightmethod.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, returns the amount of space between the columns
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gethorizontalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Returns whether horizontal lines between the rows are visible in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gethorizontallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalScrollable
methods.docu:
Returns whether the horizontal scrollbar will appear if there are more
columns than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_gethorizontalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: getHorizontalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns whether to show a horizontal scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setHorizontalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm), or to show the horizontal scrollbar only as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_gethorizontalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: getInsertMode
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) value that indicates whether the editor is in insert mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getinsertmode.htm)

methods.name: getInterspace
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method is
deprecated; use [getHorizontalCellSpacing](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gethorizontalcellspacing.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getinterspace.htm)

methods.name: getLeftColumn
methods.docu: Returns the current visible left-most column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getleftcolumn.htm)

methods.name: getLineColor
methods.docu: Returns the color of the separator lines in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getlinecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridAlignment
methods.docu: Returns the alignment of the cells in the main part of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) (not including the row or column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_getmaingridalignment.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridBackColor
methods.docu: Returns the default background color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridFont
methods.docu: Returns the default font of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_getmaingridfont.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridForeColor
methods.docu: Returns the default foreground color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridforecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridStripeColor
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the background stripe color
of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getmaingridstripecolor.htm)

methods.name: getMainGridVerticalAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the vertical alignment of the cells in the main part of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) (not including the row or column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_getmaingridverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: getMaxVisibleColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum number of columns
that will fit inside the visible viewing area of the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getMaxVisibleColumns.htm)

methods.name: getMaxVisibleRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum number of rows
that will fit inside the visible viewing area of the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getMaxVisibleRows.htm)

methods.name: getNumColumns
methods.docu: Returns the number of columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getnumcolumns.htm)

methods.name: getNumRows
methods.docu: Returns the number of rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getnumrows.htm)

methods.name: getPagingAmount
methods.docu:
Returns the number of rows to scroll when scrolling by page in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getpagingamount.htm)

methods.name: getRowData
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
row or rows. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getRowData.htm)

methods.name: getRowData
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
a range of specified [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
row or rows. The data returned is a snapshot of the current
state of the grid only and does not get updated if anything changes within
the BBjGrid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getRowData.htm)

methods.name: getRowGutter
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the number of pixels separating
the row header and the main grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_getrowgutter.htm)

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getrowheight.htm)

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getrowheight.htm)

methods.name: getRowStyleNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all CSS styles names that
have been added to a grid row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cssstyle/bbjgrid_getrowstylenames.htm)

methods.name: getRowVerticalAlignment
methods.docu: In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the vertical alignment of all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_getRowVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: getScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent
methods.docu: In BBj 20.10 and higher, this method returns value of the boolean flag indicating whether the [BBjGridHitTopEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhittopevent/bbjgridhittopevent.htm) and [BBjGridHitBottomEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhitbottomevent/bbjgridhitbottomevent.htm) events will trigger from the scrollbar.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/BBjGrid_getScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent.htm)

methods.name: getScrollOutside
methods.docu:
Returns whether the grid will scroll when the mouse cursor is moved
outside the bounds of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
during a drag and drop operation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getscrolloutside.htm)

methods.name: getScrollUpdate
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
updates while being scrolled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_getscrollupdate.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCell
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_getSelectedCell.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the selected cells in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection
mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple cells.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_getSelectedCells.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedColumn
methods.docu: Returns the currently selected column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedcolumn.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the
selected columns in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode
([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple columns.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedcolumns.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedRow
methods.docu: Returns the currently selected row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedRows
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the
selected rows in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)),
then the BBjVector may contain multiple rows.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectedrows.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionBackground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current background [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value for a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionBackground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionForeground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns the current foreground [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm) value for a selection
in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_getSelectionForeground.htm)

methods.name: getSelectionMode
methods.docu: Returns the selection mode of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_getselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire column of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_getShouldHighlightSelectedColumn.htm)

methods.name: getShouldHighlightSelectedRow
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the grid will highlight
the entire row of the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getshouldhighlightselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: getShowMaskWhenRendering
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether
input style cells display the decoration characters of their mask in non-edit
mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getshowmaskwhenrendering.htm)

methods.name: getSnapToRowHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether the gird will adjust its height so that only full rows appear in the grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_getsnaptorowheight.htm)

methods.name: getStartEditSelectionMode
methods.docu: In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns the selection mode that will be used when starting to edit a cell in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_getstarteditselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: getStringWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of a string in pixels in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_getstringwidth.htm)

methods.name: getStripeCount
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the number of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) rows to alternate between the stripe color and the default background color.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_getstripecount.htm)

methods.name: getTabAction
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the current tab action in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm)

methods.name: getTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells
methods.docu: When the user presses Tab key while focus is on a grid cell, the focus will move based on the current TabAction of the grid (see [getTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm), [setTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)). If the program has called setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells(TRUE), then the focus will skip any cells that are not editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabactionskipsnoneditablecells.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getTopRow
methods.docu: Returns the current top visible row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_gettoprow.htm)

methods.name: getVerticalScrollBarAlways

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.docu: Scrolls down in order to set the bottom row visible in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_scrolltobottom.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure

methods.name: setCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
the [BBjGridCell](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm) data
to the grid. The default data contained within the BBjGridCell
will not get updated to the grid. Only the changed user specific data
within the BBjGridCell will be updated to the grid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setCell.htm)

methods.name: setCells
methods.docu:

a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjGridCells](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgridcell/BBjGridCell.htm)
to the grid. The default data contained within the BBjGridCells will not
get updated to the grid. Only the changed user-specific data within the
BBjGridCells will be changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setCells.htm)

methods.name: setColumnEditable

methods.name: setColumnVisible

Scrolls the BBjGrid, if necessary, to ensure that the specified column

methods.name: setColumnWidth

when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

methods.name: setDragType
methods.docu:

an individual grid column or cell advertises to potential drop targets
when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)

data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes
methods.docu:

or cell is willing to accept from a drag source when the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
acts as a drop target. If no drop types are set, the grid will accept
data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/draganddrop/bbjgrid_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled

methods.name: setEnterAsTab

In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method sets whether an

as though a TAB key had been pressed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setenterastab.htm)

methods.name: setFitToGrid
