methods.name: setHasColumnHeader
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
has a column header.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_sethascolumnheader.htm)

methods.name: setHeaderSelection
methods.docu: Sets whether a header cell will display as recessed if the row/column is selected in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setheaderselection.htm)

methods.name: setHighlightMethod
methods.docu: Sets the highlight method for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_sethighlightmethod.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, sets the amount of space between the columns
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Sets whether the horizontal lines between the rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
are visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalScrollable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the horizontal scrollbar will appear if there are more
columns than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: setHorizontalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets whether to always show a horizontal scrollbar enabled using [BBjGrid::setHorizontalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollable.htm), or to only show as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_sethorizontalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: setInsertMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method controls whether the editor is in
insert mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellcontents/bbjgrid_setinsertmode.htm)

methods.name: setInterspace
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method is
deprecated; use [setHorizontalCellSpacing](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_sethorizontalcellspacing.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setinterspace.htm)

methods.name: setLeftColumn
methods.docu: In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method sets a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) to be the left-most visible column.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setleftcolumn.htm)

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.docu: Sets the line color of the vertical and horizontal lines in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setlinecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridAlignment
methods.docu:
Sets the alignment for all of the cells in the main area of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
(not including the row and column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setmaingridalignment.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the default background color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridFont
methods.docu: Sets the default font used in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/fonts/bbjgrid_setmaingridfont.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the default foreground color of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridStripeColor
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets an optional background stripe color of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setmaingridstripecolor.htm)

methods.name: setMainGridVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets the vertical alignment for all
of the cells in the main area of the BBjGrid (not including the row and
column headers).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/bbjgrid_setmaingridverticalalignment.htm)

methods.name: setMouseCapture
methods.docu: Sets whether to capture mouse movement events in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setmousecapture.htm)

methods.name: setMultipleSelection
methods.docu: Sets whether multiple cells/rows/columns can be selected in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)

methods.name: setPaging
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be scrolled by paging buttons ( and ).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setpaging.htm)

methods.name: setPagingAmount
methods.docu: Sets the number of rows to scroll when scrolling by page in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setpagingamount.htm)

methods.name: setRowGutter
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the number of pixels separating
the row header and the main [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/headers/bbjgrid_setrowgutter.htm)

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.docu: Sets the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowheight.htm)

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.docu: Sets the height of a row(s) in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowheight.htm)

methods.name: setRowVerticalAlignment
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
the vertical alignment for all cells in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) row.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellalignment/BBjGrid_setRowVerticalAlignment.htm)

methods.name: setRowVisible
methods.docu:
Scrolls the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm),
if necessary, to ensure that the specified row appears within the visible
area.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setrowvisible.htm)

methods.name: setScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent
methods.docu: In BBj 20.10 and higher, this method sets a flag to enable or disable the [BBjGridHitTopEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhittopevent/bbjgridhittopevent.htm) and [BBjGridHitBottomEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/bbjgridhitbottomevent/bbjgridhitbottomevent.htm) events while scrolling.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/BBjGrid_setScrollbarTriggerTopBottomEvent.htm)

methods.name: setScrollOutside
methods.docu:
Sets whether the grid scrolls during a drag and drop operation when
the mouse cursor is moved outside the bounds of the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setscrolloutside.htm)

methods.name: setScrollUpdate
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
updates the display of data in the cells while being scrolled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setscrollupdate.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedCell
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method selects a cell in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setSelectedCell.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedCells
methods.docu: In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method selects multiple cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setSelectedCells.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedColumn
methods.docu: Selects a column in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedcolumn.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedColumns
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method selects multiple columns in the
[BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedcolumns.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedRow
methods.docu: Selects a row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: setSelectedRows
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method selects multiple rows in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectedrows.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionBackground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets the background [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value for a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_setSelectionBackground.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionForeground
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets the foreground [BBjColor](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcolor/bbjcolor_bbj.htm)
value of a selection in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_setSelectionForeground.htm)

methods.name: setSelectionMode
methods.docu: Sets the method to select cells in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: setShouldHighlightSelectedColumn
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will highlight
the entire column containing the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/BBjGrid_setShouldHighlightSelectedColumn.htm)

methods.name: setShouldHighlightSelectedRow
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will highlight
the entire row containing the currently selected cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setshouldhighlightselectedrow.htm)

methods.name: setShowMaskWhenRendering
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method controls whether the input style
cells displays the decoration characters of their mask in non-edit mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/deprecated/bbjgrid_setshowmaskwhenrendering.htm)

methods.name: setSnapToRowHeight
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets whether the grid will adjust its height so that it does not display any 'partial' rows.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setsnaptorowheight.htm)

methods.name: setStartEditSelectionMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method sets the selection mode that will
be used when a cell in a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
is edited.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_setstarteditselectionmode.htm)

methods.name: setStripeCount
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the number of [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) rows to alternate between the stripe color and the default background color[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/bbjgrid_setstripecount.htm)

methods.name: setTabAction
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets the current tab action in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)

methods.name: setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells
methods.docu: When the user presses Tab key while focus is on a grid cell, the focus will move based on the current TabAction of the grid (see [getTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_gettabaction.htm), [setTabAction](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabaction.htm)). If the program has called setTabActionSkipsNonEditableCells(TRUE) then the focus will skip any cells that are not editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_settabactionskipsnoneditablecells.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the tooltip text (also known as short cue in BBx) for the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm) or for a specific grid column or cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: setTopRow
methods.docu: Sets a row to be the top visible row in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_settoprow.htm)

methods.name: setTrimBlankSpace
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, when a grid is larger in size
than the size required to display the table and all required headers and
scrollbars, this method controls whether the grid will be trimmed to the
minimum size to display the table, headers and scrollbars.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/bbjgrid_settrimblankspace.htm)

methods.name: setUserResizable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the columns in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm)
can be resized by the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setuserresizable.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalCellSpacing
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, sets the amount of space between the rows in
the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setverticalcellspacing.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalLinesVisible
methods.docu:
Sets whether the vertical lines between the columns are to be visible
in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/rowsandcolumns/bbjgrid_setverticallinesvisible.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalScrollable
methods.docu:
Sets whether the vertical scrollbar will appear if there are more rows
than can be displayed in the space given in the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setverticalscrollable.htm)

methods.name: setVerticalScrollBarAlways
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets whether to always show a vertical scrollbar enabled using [setVerticalScrollable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setverticalscrollable.htm), or to only show the vertical scrollbar as needed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_setverticalscrollbaralways.htm)

methods.name: setViewportColor
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets the viewport color for a [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/colors/BBjGrid_setViewPortColor.htm)

methods.name: setCalendarSize
methods.docu: In BBj 25.02 and higher, this method sets the size of the popup calendar associated with [BBjInputD](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjinputd/bbjinputd.htm) cells on this grid control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/BBjGrid_setCalendarSize.htm)

methods.name: showCalendarForCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method programmatically calls the calendar
popup on an InputD cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/BBjGrid_showCalendarForCell.htm)

methods.name: showCalendarForCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method programmatically calls the calendar
popup on an InputD cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/BBjGrid_showCalendarForCell.htm)

methods.name: showCalendarForCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method programmatically calls the calendar
popup on an InputD cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/BBjGrid_showCalendarForCell.htm)

methods.name: showCalendarForCell
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method programmatically calls the calendar
popup on an InputD cell.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/miscfunctions/BBjGrid_showCalendarForCell.htm)

methods.name: suppressUpdatesWhileScrolling
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method suppresses update requests to the program while the user scrolls the [BBjGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/BBjGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/scrolling/bbjgrid_suppressupdateswhilescrolling.htm)

methods.name: setCallback
methods.docu: This method registers the callback routine for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcallback.htm)

methods.name: setCallback
methods.docu: This method registers the callback routine for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcallback.htm)

methods.name: setCallback
methods.docu: This method registers the callback routine for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcallback.htm)

methods.name: clearCallback
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method unregisters the callback routine
for a specified event of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_clearcallback.htm)

methods.name: getContextID
methods.docu: Returns the context ID of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcontextid.htm)

methods.name: addPopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method adds a popup menu to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_addpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: setPopupMenu
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds a pre-existing popup menu to
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: getPopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method retrieves a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: removePopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method removes a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removepopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: setText

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setSlot
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into a parent BBjControl that's assumed to be a web component. If a non-blank [slot name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_templates_and_slots#adding_flexibility_with_slots) is specified, the child BBjControl is placed in the specified slot within the parent BBjControl.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setSlot.htm)

classes.name: RecordSetBindable
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, any [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
that supports binding to a [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm)
implements the RecordSetBindable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable.htm)

methods.name: bindRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds the [RecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable.htm) to a particular field from a [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_bindrecordset.htm)

methods.name: getBoundFieldName
methods.docu: In 5.0 and higher, this method returns the field name that is bound to this control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_getboundfieldname.htm)

methods.name: getBoundRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm) to which this [SimpleRecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable.htm) object has previously been bound.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable_getboundrecordset.htm)

methods.name: unbindRecordSet
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method removes the binding between this [SimpleRecordSetBindable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable.htm) object and any [BBjRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm) to which it was previously bound.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_SimpleRecordSetBindable/interface_simplerecordsetbindable_unbindrecordset.htm)

classes.name: BBjBarChart
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, the BBjBarChart control displays data in a bar
chart format.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjbarchart/bbjbarchart.htm)

methods.name: setTitle

methods.name: getTitle

methods.name: setYLabel

methods.name: isLegendShown
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this [BBjBarChart](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjbarchart/bbjbarchart.htm) method returns true if the legend will be shown on this chart.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjbarchart/bbjbarchart_islegendshown.htm)

methods.name: setLegendShown
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method specifies
whether this [BBjBarChart](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjbarchart/bbjbarchart.htm)
should show a legend.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjbarchart/BBjBarChart_setLegendShown.htm)

methods.name: clearData

methods.name: getClientChart
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a client object that represents the client-side bar chart.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjchart/bbjchart_getclientchart.htm)

methods.name: getClientChartPanel
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
a ClientObject that delegates to the underlying
[JFreeChart](http://www.jfree.org/jfreechart/) [ChartPanel](https://www.jfree.org/jfreechart/api/javadoc/org/jfree/chart/ChartPanel.html) . This ClientObject can be used to perform
more advanced operations with JFreeCharts.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjchart/BBjChart_getClientChartPanel.htm)

methods.name: writePNGToServer
methods.docu:

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method the actions that will be allowed when this control acts as a drop target.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdropactions.htm)

methods.name: getDropActions
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control. Returns ACTION_NONE if the control is disabled or non-editable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_getdropactions.htm)

methods.name: setDropTypes

If no drop types are set, the control will accept data of any type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_DropTarget/interface_droptarget_setdroptypes.htm)

methods.name: getDropTypes

In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets the size of a tab image in
the [BBjTabCtrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjtabctrl/BBjTabCtrl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjtabctrl/BBjTabCtrl_setImageSizeAt.htm)

methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the current width of the

methods.name: setSlotAt
methods.docu: In BBj 24.11 and higher, this method moves a child BBjControl into the DWC web component on a specified tab. methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

classes.name: BBjHtmlEdit
classes.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, the BBjHtmlEdit control implements a rich text editor backed by HTML.

In BBj 19.00 and higher, setting the [STBL("!OPTIONS")](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm)
CHROMIUM_HTMLEDIT option to TRUE makes the BBjHtmlEdit control in the Java Swing GUI client use a Chromium
engine (if available). In this configuration, the BBjHtmlEdit uses an
embedded Chromium-based web browser, with support for HTML5, CSS, and
JavaScript.

In BBj 25.00 and higher, the editor component for the BUI and DWC browser clients is an
internal BASIS editor with the same toolbar options as the GUI CHROMIUM_HTMLEDIT editor.
In BBj 24.12 and higher, a preview of this internal editor component can be configured by
setting the [STBL("!OPTIONS")](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm)
BASIS_HTMLEDIT option to TRUE. All third party editor components have been removed as of BBj 25.00.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Window/bbjhtmledit/BBjHtmlEdit.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

manipulating a GUI image control on a BBj Window. Do not confuse BBjImageCtrl
with [BBjImage](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjimagemanager/bbjimage/bbjimage.htm), an image object that can be

In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method binds a pre-existing popup menu to
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: getPopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method retrieves a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getpopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: removePopupMenu
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method removes a popup menu from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removepopupmenu.htm)

methods.name: setText
methods.docu: Sets the text in the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_settext.htm)

methods.name: getText
methods.docu: Returns the text that appears in the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gettext.htm)

methods.name: getBackColor
methods.docu: Returns the background color of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setBackColor
methods.docu: Sets the background color for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setbackcolor.htm)

methods.name: setForeColor
methods.docu: Sets the foreground (text) color for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setforecolor.htm)

methods.name: getForeColor
methods.docu: Returns the foreground (text) color of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getforecolor.htm)

methods.name: setFont
methods.docu: Sets the font for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setfont.htm)

methods.name: getFont
methods.docu: Returns the font of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getfont.htm)

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is enabled or disabled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isenabled.htm)

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.docu:
Sets whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is to be enabled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm)

methods.name: setVisible
methods.docu:
Sets whether or not the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setvisible.htm)

methods.name: isVisible
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is visible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isvisible.htm)

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.docu:
Sets the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_settooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.docu:
Returns the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gettooltiptext.htm)

methods.name: showToolTipText
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method shows the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) (also
known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

methods.name: showToolTipText
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method shows the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) (also
known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_showToolTipText.htm)

methods.name: setShortCue
methods.docu:
Sets the text that appears above the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setshortcue.htm)

methods.name: getShortCue
methods.docu:
Returns the tooltip text for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
(also known as short cue in BBx).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getshortcue.htm)

methods.name: setLongCue
methods.docu:
Sets the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlongcue.htm)

methods.name: getLongCue
methods.docu:
Returns the text that appears in the status bar for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
when the mouse is positioned over the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getlongcue.htm)

methods.name: isGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous
control IDs.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_isGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setGrouped
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method sets whether
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
is part of a [keyboard
navigation group](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/keyboard_focus_navigation_and_default_button.htm), along with other BBjControls with contiguous control
ids.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setGrouped.htm)

methods.name: setCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method sets whether entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getCausesControlValidation
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method returns whether or not entering the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
will trigger control validation on the control that previously had focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcausescontrolvalidation.htm)

methods.name: getBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) will beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) in response to a validation event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setBeepOnValidationFailure
methods.docu: In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method sets whether a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) should beep when the application calls [accept(0)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Validateable/interface_validateable_accept.htm) during validation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setBeepOnValidationFailure.htm)

methods.name: setSize
methods.docu: Sets the size of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setsize.htm)

methods.name: getWidth
methods.docu: Returns the width of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getwidth.htm)

methods.name: getHeight
methods.docu: Returns the height of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getheight.htm)

methods.name: setLocation
methods.docu: Sets the location of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setlocation.htm)

methods.name: getX
methods.docu: Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getx.htm)

methods.name: getY
methods.docu: Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_gety.htm)

methods.name: getScreenX
methods.docu:
Returns the X coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreenx.htm)

methods.name: getScreenY
methods.docu:
Returns the Y coordinate of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
on the screen.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getscreeny.htm)

methods.name: setClientEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a client (lowered) border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setclientedge.htm)

methods.name: getClientEdge
methods.docu: Returns whether the client (lowered) border is set for the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getclientedge.htm)

methods.name: setRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
to have a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setraisededge.htm)

methods.name: getRaisedEdge
methods.docu:
Returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
has a raised border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getraisededge.htm)

methods.name: setNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) to have no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setnoedge.htm)

methods.name: getNoEdge
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has no border.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getnoedge.htm)

methods.name: setOpaque
methods.docu: In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method sets the opaque property of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setopaque.htm)

methods.name: isOpaque
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, this method returns the opaque property of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isopaque.htm)

methods.name: focus
methods.docu: Sets the focus on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_focus.htm)

methods.name: getID
methods.docu: Returns the ID of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getid.htm)

methods.name: getControlType
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method returns the control type of the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getcontroltype.htm)

methods.name: destroy
methods.docu: This method destroys a control. It removes the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) from the window and allows its ID to be used again.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_destroy.htm)

methods.name: isDestroyed
methods.docu: [Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_isdestroyed.htm)

methods.name: setUserData
methods.docu: In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method associates an Object with the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)

methods.name: getUserData
methods.docu:
In BBj 3.01 and higher, this method retrieves user data associated with
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
using the method [setUserData().](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setuserdata.htm)
If setUserData() was not previously called on the control, then getUserData
returns BBjNull.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getuserdata.htm)

methods.name: setCursor
methods.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, this
method sets the cursor style on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setcursor.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getname.htm)

methods.name: setName
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets the name of a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setname.htm)

methods.name: addStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method adds a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_addstyle.htm)

methods.name: removeStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method removes a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style name from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_removestyle.htm)

methods.name: clearStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method clears [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
styles from the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_clearstyles.htm)

methods.name: getStyles
methods.docu:
In BBj 11.00 and higher, this method gets a list of all [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
style names that have been added to the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_getstyles.htm)

methods.name: setStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method sets
a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm) property on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setStyle.htm)

methods.name: getStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the value of a [CSS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/css_api.htm)
property explicitly set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getStyle.htm)

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the resolved value of a CSS property
currently in effect on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getComputedStyle.htm)

methods.name: unsetStyle
methods.docu: In BBj 23.00 and higher, this method unsets a CSS property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_unsetStyle.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets a control attribute on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a control attribute for
the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
previously set with [BBjControl::setAttribute](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setAttribute.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getAttribute.htm)

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method returns a boolean value indicating whether the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm) has the specified attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu: In BBj 22.13 and higher, this method removes a control attribute.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_removeAttribute.htm)

methods.name: putClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets a client property on the
[BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: getClientProperty
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a client property previously
set on the [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
with [BBjControl::putClientProperty](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_putClientProperty.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_getClientProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty
methods.docu: In BBj 24.00 and higher, this method sets a property on the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl_setProperty.htm)

methods.name: setProperty

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isEditable
methods.docu: Returns a value indicating whether or not the user can edit the control.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Editable/interface_editable_iseditable.htm)

methods.name: getHighlightOnFocus

classes.name: Focusable
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, a [BBjControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/BBjControl.htm)
implements the Focusable interface
if the user can focus the control via either the mouse or keyboard.

Note:

A focused control is the
control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the
focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A
control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated
via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable
control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the
mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm)
and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, isFocusable returns a value indicating whether or not the user can focus the control.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_isfocusable.htm)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, setFocusable sets whether a control can be focused.

Note:

A focused control is the control to which keyboard interaction is directed. Typically, the focused control is indicated visually, often via a dotted grey border. A control which is not focusable, therefore, cannot be manipulated via the keyboard. It is still possible to interact with a non-focusable control via the mouse. To disable all interaction, including the mouse, see [setEnabled()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/SysGui/bbjcontrol/bbjcontrol_setenabled.htm) and [setEditable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellediting/bbjgrid_seteditable.htm)().[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_Focusable/interface_focusable_setfocusable.htm)

methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the actions that are currently available when dropping to this control.
